matched_amounts_disjoint_bits_hold.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

limit_order_matching_reverts.meaning: limit order matching (partial or full) reverts, affecting all limit order matching while fill orders remain unaffected

assumptions: The zero-cost trade guard is the validation step whose behavior determines whether legitimate limit order matching completes.
Fill orders use different validation logic and are outside this claim's scope.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a numeric definition of the zero-cost condition (which side receives tokens without sending any); the guard's correct behavior is encoded as a grounded Boolean relation rather than a numeric inequality.
The disjoint-bit matched amounts are described as a potential conditional scenario rather than an observed prior state; the precondition is encoded as a Boolean condition.

limitations: The impact text describes the affected scope (all limit order matching, fill orders unaffected) rather than a distinct numeric outcome; the revert outcome is encoded as a Boolean occurrence symbol.
No caller identity or authorization condition is supported by the report and none is encoded.
